actions.signature_quote: The Schedule named households. The Record names ground. Ground does not argue.
actions.access_rule: Scrape three plates without writing a lived name or a Continuity number, and Overlay labour withdraws. They do not raid. Rooms go dark of juniors. Posts stay posts.

actions.signature_quote: Water is counted because uncounted water disappears into someone else's cellar.
actions.access_rule: Maintain metered cistern quotas and settle overdraw debts before each dawn bell; tampering with flow restrictors terminates drawing rights at every district conduit.

actions.signature_quote: The war burned the houses, but the property line between the ashes remains recorded.
actions.access_rule: Submit boundary disputes to formal council hearing and accept sworn survey markers; violence against field registrars voids all historical parcel claims.

actions.signature_quote: Nothing in the dust is safe; safety is only the premium someone agreed to pay.
actions.access_rule: Pay risk premiums in advance and report cargo manifests honestly; concealing hazardous goods or defaulting on contract indemnity forfeits depot protection.

actions.signature_quote: The road doesn't belong to the banner flying over it; it belongs to the crew chipping ice at four in the morning.
actions.access_rule: Pay column road maintenance tolls in iron or coal and obey bridge axle limits; running a closed pass during blizzard warnings closes all waystation gates to your wagons.

actions.signature_quote: The tide doesn't care whose seal is on the parchment; if the seams aren't pitched, the cargo sinks.
actions.access_rule: Register cargo manifests at Berth 9 and pay wharfage in copper or pitch; docking uninspected hulls or discharging tainted bilge bars your vessels from coastal waterways.

actions.signature_quote: You cannot eat an imperial victory; you can eat what four women planted in the muck ninety days ago.
actions.access_rule: Honor minuted trade quotas and refrain from carrying weapons onto the grain exchange floor; hoarding seed chits during planting season results in immediate civic expulsion.

actions.signature_quote: A border isn't a line on paper; it's the ditch someone agreed to stand in with loaded rifles.
actions.access_rule: Present authorized travel chits at the outer wire and submit to weapons inspection; evading road checkpoints or concealing contraband results in immediate internment.
